project_type: Next.js 16.4.3 App Router (Turbopack) + React 19.3.1 + next-intl 4.14.9 (en, ne) ministry website; adding Prisma 7 + PostgreSQL and an Auth.js v5 admin CMS
build_system: npm 11.19.1 on Node v24.22.1 (Windows, PowerShell). .npmrc has save-exact=true; package.json must have no ^/~ ranges. package.json has no "type" field, so tsx runs scripts as CommonJS (no top-level await in scripts). npm 11 does not run dependency install scripts for prisma/@prisma/engines/@embedded-postgres/windows-x64 (works anyway on Windows; do not approve scripts blindly). `prisma generate` runs via postinstall and pretypecheck; generated client goes to src/generated/prisma (gitignored).
test_framework: Vitest 5.0.5 with test.projects `unit` (jsdom, src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx} + scripts/**/*.test.ts, excludes *.db.test.ts) and `db` (node, *.db.test.ts in src/ and prisma/, globalSetup starts embedded Postgres and recreates mission_unit). Playwright 1.64.1 + @axe-core/playwright 4.14.0, port 3210, projects public/setup/admin-readonly/admin-mutations.
build_command: npm run build (requires `npm run db:start` + migrated/seeded mission_dev because public pages are SSG and read the DB)
test_command: npm test (both vitest projects); npx vitest --run --project unit; npx vitest --run --project db; npx playwright test --reporter=list
verification_instructions: 1) npm run format then npm run format:check. 2) npm run lint. 3) npm run typecheck. 4) npm run db:start; npm run db:migrate; npm run db:seed (x2). 5) npm run build. 6) npm test. 7) npx playwright test --reporter=list (webServer runs e2e:prepare + build + start itself; do not start a server manually). 8) Open screenshots in .agents/screenshots/ and .agents/screenshots/admin/ and describe them. 9) Hygiene commands from plan.md 'Full verification checklist' item 12. 10) npm run db:stop. Record everything in c:/Users/rasaily/Downloads/mission app/.agents/tasks/phase4-5/verification.md.
snapshot_or_generated_files: prisma/migrations/<ts>_init/migration.sql is created by `npm run db:migrate -- --name init` and kept in the working tree. src/generated/prisma (gitignored) from `prisma generate`. Screenshots .agents/screenshots/home-*.png (existing e2e/screenshots.spec.ts) and .agents/screenshots/admin/*.png (new admin-screenshots spec) are regenerated by Playwright; .agents/screenshots/ is gitignored. playwright/.auth/*.json (gitignored) written by e2e-prepare and auth.setup.
environment_constraints: Project root c:\Users\rasaily\Downloads\mission app contains a space: always quote paths and pass cwd. NO git worktree, NEVER git add/commit/push (repo has zero commits). Never run `npm run dev`/`npm start` in the foreground. Local Postgres via embedded-postgres on 127.0.0.1:54329, data in .local/postgres; pg_ctl must be spawned from Node with stdio 'ignore' (PowerShell capture hangs); initdb needs --encoding=UTF8 --locale=C (else WIN1252 breaks Devanagari). spawnSync('npx') fails on this machine: use runPrisma (process.execPath + prisma/build/index.js). Never put Neon URLs in local .env; destructive commands are fenced by scripts/assert-local-db.ts. Do not run npm test and Playwright simultaneously. Never print AUTH_SECRET/TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY/TOTP secrets/passwords into evidence.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering in repo. Requirements come from the user request and design TASK: no AWS anywhere; Neon prod; Docker-free local Postgres; exact pinned deps; OWNER exactly one (CLI), EDITOR max 3 active; Argon2id + AES-256-GCM-encrypted TOTP; requireAdmin/requireOwner server-side in every page/action/route handler; Zod + AuditLog via runAdminAction; sanitized Markdown; en+ne with ne->en fallback; /admin excluded from i18n proxy, sitemap, robots, noindex + security headers; DO NOT change the header layout (logo+name left, nav center, Support the Mission CTA right); be honest that uploads arrive in Phase 7 (URL fields with hint).

UI primitives in src/components/ui/* (Button variants, Card, Input/Textarea/Checkbox/Label/FieldError with invalid/errorId, Badge + DemoBadge tone, EmptyState, Skeleton) exported from src/components/ui/index.ts; cn() in src/lib/cn.ts; brand tokens navy/ivory/beige/gold in src/app/globals.css. Radix Dialog pattern in src/components/layout/MobileMenu.tsx. Content view models in src/lib/content.ts (PostSummary, EventSummary, VerseView, MediaSummary, FeaturedItem) consumed by src/components/home/*. Demo data in src/content/demo/{posts,events,verses,media,types}.ts (ids post-1..6, event-1..4, isaiah-6-8/john-3-16/psalm-23-1, media-1..3). Existing tests: src/lib/{content,messages,i18n-path}.test.ts, src/components/ui/*.test.tsx, src/components/home/RecentUpdates.test.tsx; e2e/{a11y,language-switcher,mobile-menu,navigation,routing,screenshots}.spec.ts.
